  KEY TAKEAWAYS:
 India chased down 198 in Wellington to clinch the T20I series against New Zealand. 
 Abhishek Sharma smashed a 15-ball fifty, the joint third-fastest by an Indian in T20Is.
 Abhishek also owns the fastest T20I hundred, a 30-ball effort against Afghanistan in Delhi.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Faster than Chris Gayle? Abhishek Sharma destroys New Zealand in Wellington to help India clinch the series
 The race for the fastest century in T20 cricket has plenty of famous names in it, and Abhishek Sharma added another headline to the story in Wellington on Tuesday. India wrapped up the T20I series against New Zealand there, and the left-handed opener played a big part in making the win look easy.
 Abhishek was the star of the chase, and he reached his half-century in only 15 balls, which ties him for the third-fastest fifty by an Indian in T20 internationals. His blistering start also helped India post a record powerplay total in T20Is after posting 118/0 in the first six overs. 
 The earlier record belonged to Romania, who made 116 without loss in 5.4 overs while completing a chase against Serbia in 2021.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement Abhishek reached his century in 35 balls before getting dismissed for 113 off 38 balls.

 Fastest IPL centuries: Chris Gayle leads, Vaibhav Sooryavanshi appears twice
 In the IPL, Chris Gayle's 30-ball hundred for Royal Challengers Bangalore against Pune Warriors in 2013 still stands at the top.
 Vaibhav Sooryavanshi sits second and third, with a 35-ball century for Rajasthan Royals against Gujarat Titans in Jaipur in April 2025 and a 36-ball effort against Sunrisers Hyderabad in the same city in April 2026.
